### Arguments

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--design_formula`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The formula should be a tilde (~) followed by the variables with plus signs between them.
The design formula is used to estimate the dispersions and to estimate the log2 fold changes of the model.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"~ disease + treatment"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contrast_column`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Column in the metadata to use for the contrast.
This column should contain the conditions to compare.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"treatment"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contrast_values`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Values to compare in the contrast column.
First value is the control group, following values are comparison groups.
Values must be present in the fields specified for the design formula.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"ctrl"`, `"stim"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--p_adj_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Adjusted p-value threshold for significance, corrected with the Benjamini and Hochberg method.
Genes with adjusted p-values below this threshold will be considered significant.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.05`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--log2fc_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Log2 fold change threshold for significance.
Genes with absolute log2 fold change above this threshold will be considered significant.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::::

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_dir`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Output directory for DESeq2 results.
If cell groups are defined (using `--obs_cell_group`), the output folder will contain one CSV per cell group, otherwise it will contain a single output file.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_prefix`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Prefix for output CSV files.
If no cell groups are specified, the output file will be named "{prefix}.csv".
If cell groups are specified, files will be named "{prefix}_{cell_group}.csv".
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"deseq2_analysis"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/differential_expression/deseq2/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/differential_expression/deseq2);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/differential_expression/deseq2/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
